answer_1.quote: We evaluate models trained with ConsistentChat on LIGHT, TOPDIAL, and MT-EVAL benchmarks... The purpose of the dialogue model is to generate an overall model response ... while maintaining chat consistency across turns.
answer_1.outputs: Multi-turn dialogues (user queries and agent responses) with chat consistency annotations

answer_2.quote: We employed three representative multi-turn dialogue benchmarks to evaluate the performance... We utilized Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct as evaluator and three tasks... The average Spearman correlation reaches 0.68.

answer_3.quote: We utilized Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct to assign a chat consistency score, ranging from 1 to 10, to each multi-turn dialogue from the ShareGPT... We used the LLM-as-a-Judge method.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three well-educated graduate students as annotators to score 50 randomly selected multi-turn dialogues from each benchmark.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to score the overall consistency of each dialogue on a 1‑10 scale.
